spec2def(cryptui.dll cryptui.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

# cryptui.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/cryptui-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(cryptui_shims OBJECT main.c)
target_link_libraries(cryptui_shims PRIVATE uuid wine oldnames wine_dll_register libuser32 libole32 libcrypt32 libgdi32 libadvapi32 libcomctl32 libcomdlg32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
target_compile_definitions(cryptui_shims PRIVATE _WINE)
set_wine_module_fixme(cryptui_shims)
add_cargo_module(cryptui cryptui-cargo cryptui.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    DELAY_IMPORTS
    EXTRA_DEPENDS cryptui_shims psdk uuid_sources)
